name: submit_i9_verification
description: submit_i9_verification: Submit or update I-9 work authorization verification for an employee. For initial verification, the employee must have a populated onboarding checklist in the system. For reverification, a prior I-9 record must already exist. Returns a case_id on success.

employee_id.description: The employee's ID. Format: EMP followed by 6 digits. Example: EMP072948

verification_action.description: The action type: initial_verification (first-time I-9) or reverification (updating expiring documents)

document_list_type.description: The I-9 document list: LIST_A (single document proving both identity and work authorization), LIST_B (identity only), or LIST_C (work authorization only)

document_type_code.description: The document type. US_PASSPORT (U.S. passport or passport card, LIST_A). PERM_RESIDENT_CARD (Permanent Resident / green card, LIST_A). EAD (Employment Authorization Document, LIST_A). DRIVERS_LICENSE (state-issued driver's license, LIST_B identity). STATE_ID (state-issued non-driver ID, LIST_B identity). SSN_CARD (unrestricted Social Security card, LIST_C work auth). BIRTH_CERT (U.S. birth certificate, LIST_C work auth).

document_number.description: The document's ID number, 6-12 uppercase alphanumeric characters. Must be captured exactly as provided by the caller. Example: A12345678

document_expiration_date.description: The document's expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: 2030-08-14

issuing_country_code.description: The 2-letter ISO country code of the issuing country. Convert country names to codes. Example: US, IN, MX
